nodes.label: pnpm Workspace Configuration
nodes.rationale: nodeLinker hoisted + hoistingLimits workspaces chosen because React Native tooling assumes a flat node_modules and pnpm's isolated linker breaks autolinking/codegen; React/react-dom pinned exactly (not ^) because a `^` range in apps/* would let pnpm update split web and mobile onto different React versions, and duplicate React is a runtime error.
